mapper.sql: SELECT final_selection.final_selection_id, strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_option.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.case_code, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.case_status, final_selection.created_at AS established_at, final_selection.last_synced_at, sku.sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, sku.unit_code, product.product_name, product.image_url, strategy_option.option_name, strategy_option.recommendation_reason FROM ( SELECT selection.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY selection.strategy_case_id ORDER BY selection.created_at DESC, selection.final_selection_id DESC ) AS selection_rank FROM final_strategy_selection selection WHERE selection.is_deleted = 0 ) final_selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = final_selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 JOIN strategy_option ON strategy_option.strategy_option_id = final_selection.strategy_option_id AND strategy_option.strategy_case_id = strategy_case.strategy_case_id AND strategy_option.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sku ON sku.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id AND sku.is_deleted = 0 JOIN product ON product.product_id = sku.product_id AND product.is_deleted = 0 WHERE final_selection.selection_rank = 1
mapper.select: ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC
AND strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN snapshot.sales_point_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALES_POINT' ELSE 'WAREHOUSE' END AS location_type, COALESCE(snapshot.sales_point_id, snapshot.warehouse_id) AS location_id, COALESCE(sales_point.sales_point_code, warehouse.warehouse_code) AS location_code, COALESCE(sales_point.sales_point_name, warehouse.warehouse_name) AS location_name, SUM(snapshot.on_hand_qty) AS before_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(current_balance.inventory_balance_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(current_balance.on_hand_qty) END AS current_quantity, SUM(snapshot.safety_stock_qty) AS safety_stock_quantity FROM strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot LEFT JOIN inventory_balance current_balance ON current_balance.inventory_balance_id = snapshot.inventory_balance_id AND current_balance.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point ON sales_point.sales_point_id = snapshot.sales_point_id AND sales_point.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse ON warehouse.warehouse_id = snapshot.warehouse_id AND warehouse.is_deleted = 0 WHERE snapshot.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN snapshot.sales_point_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALES_POINT' ELSE 'WAREHOUSE' END, COALESCE(snapshot.sales_point_id, snapshot.warehouse_id), COALESCE(sales_point.sales_point_code, warehouse.warehouse_code), COALESCE(sales_point.sales_point_name, warehouse.warehouse_name) ORDER BY location_type, location_name

WITH selected_strategy AS ( SELECT final_selection.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.sku_id, TRUNC(final_selection.created_at) AS established_date FROM final_strategy_selection final_selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = final_selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 WHERE final_selection.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND final_selection.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), relevant_points AS ( SELECT action.source_sales_point_id AS sales_point_id FROM strategy_action action JOIN selected_strategy selected ON selected.strategy_option_id = action.strategy_option_id WHERE action.is_deleted = 0 AND action.action_type IN ( 'REALLOCATION', 'RT_TRANSFER', 'CHANNEL_EXPANSION', 'CHANNEL_CONCENTRATION' ) AND action.source_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT action.target_sales_point_id FROM strategy_action action JOIN selected_strategy selected ON selected.strategy_option_id = action.strategy_option_id WHERE action.is_deleted = 0 AND action.action_type IN ( 'REALLOCATION', 'RT_TRANSFER', 'CHANNEL_EXPANSION', 'CHANNEL_CONCENTRATION' ) AND action.target_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT sales.sales_date, sales.sales_point_id, sales_point.sales_point_code, sales_point.sales_point_name, sales.net_sales_qty AS quantity, sales.net_sales_amount AS revenue FROM selected_strategy selected JOIN sales_daily sales ON sales.sku_id = selected.sku_id AND sales.sales_date >= selected.established_date AND sales.sales_date < selected.established_date + 90 AND sales.sales_date <= #{asOfDate} AND sales.is_deleted = 0 JOIN relevant_points relevant ON relevant.sales_point_id = sales.sales_point_id JOIN sales_point ON sales_point.sales_point_id = sales.sales_point_id AND sales_point.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sales.sales_date, sales.sales_point_id

SELECT aggregated.performance_count, aggregated.actual_sales_quantity, aggregated.actual_revenue, aggregated.actual_contribution_margin, ( SELECT latest.actual_remaining_qty FROM strategy_performance latest WHERE latest.strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND latest.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY latest.performance_date DESC, latest.strategy_performance_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS actual_remaining_quantity, aggregated.moved_quantity, aggregated.disposed_quantity FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS performance_count, SUM(performance.actual_sales_qty) AS actual_sales_quantity, SUM(performance.actual_revenue) AS actual_revenue, SUM(performance.actual_contribution_margin) AS actual_contribution_margin, SUM(performance.moved_quantity) AS moved_quantity, SUM(performance.disposed_quantity) AS disposed_quantity FROM strategy_performance performance WHERE performance.strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND performance.is_deleted = 0 ) aggregated
